Definition: properly, to be bald, i.e. (causatively) to shave; figuratively to lay waste
BiblicalUsage: 1) to poll, shave, shave off, be bald; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to shave; 1a2) to shave off; 1a3) (fig. of devastation); 1b)(Pual) to be shaven; 1c) (Hithpael) to shave oneself
